spanish: Porque alma de toda carne su sangre en su alma ella, y dije a hijos de Israel: Sangre de toda carne no comerán, porque alma de toda carne su sangre ella; todo su comediente será cortado.

findings.issue: Pronoun is 3rd masculine singular; ella is feminine and collapses it with the later 3rd feminine pronoun.
Qal active participle is masculine plural construct with a 3ms object suffix (the thing eaten); su comediente is one singular eater.

notes: 2mp comerán is ustedes address; niphal 3ms יכרת matches será cortado.
